caller_path: subdomainmonitor.diffJSEndpoints reads live subdomains for the scanned domain
the caller supplies their HTTP(S) URLs to CollectEndpointsForHosts
resolution_path: scriptSrcRe captures an absolute HTTP URL from untrusted page HTML
ResolveReference keeps the absolute URL's origin
the collector checks HTTP(S) and a .js path but performs no origin or address-class check
downloadFile issues the request from the scanner process
scope_statement: Only use it on targets where you have explicit written permission, or on bug bounty programs where the target is in-scope.
source_review_conclusion: scriptSrcRe captures a URL from remote HTML; absolute references retain their origin; only scheme and .js path are checked before downloadFile fetches the URL. The caller obtains hosts from live subdomains for the scanned domain. README requires authorized/in-scope targets. No same-origin or private-address policy is documented, so this remains a loopback-fetch candidate with security impact unconfirmed.
